tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: hairline `line` border, `radius-xl`, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Grey tiles, accordion rows, profile-task cards, the off state of toggles and month pills.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and keyboard-highlight fill for list rows, options and menu items.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed rows and chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline: card borders, dividers between rows, the unfilled part of progress bars. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 1.5px edge of inputs, selects, steppers and outline chips (3:1 on `canvas`, `surface` and `surface-muted`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, titles, body text; fill of primary buttons, selected chips, checkboxes and the black tile. On every neutral ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: locations, timestamps, descriptions, helper text — on every neutral ground.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholders inside inputs.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels; fill of disabled buttons is `surface-pressed`.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `ink` fills: primary buttons, selected chips, the black tile, nav bars.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signal red — the accent: red tiles, the action button, links, active nav, selected date, current step, progress fill, toggles on. A fill in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on `brand` fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on `brand` fills. Bold 16px+ or caps labels only (4.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Red as text: links (bold, underlined), destructive menu items, error messages, required marks — on every neutral ground.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Error toast and the selected-row wash.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset. Ink, not red, so focus never reads as an error.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Ochre — the INTERVIEW / at-risk badge text in dark, warning icons and banner border.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: INTERVIEW and AT RISK badge fill; warning banner.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-subtle` and on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Green — success icon, toast edge, Done check.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: OFFER / DONE badge fill; success toast.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `success-subtle`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Violet — info icon and banner border, the 'in review' state.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Info banner; the +N% boost pill.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `info-subtle`.

tokens.name: neutral-subtle
tokens.usage: CLOSED / TO DO badge fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Uppercase slogans on `brand` and `ink` tiles only — two short lines, the second often in red. Condensed (font-stretch 75%).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Uppercase page and section headlines: DASHBOARD, SEARCH RESULTS (128), NO RESULTS. Condensed.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sentence-case titles: issue card titles, page headers in app bars. Condensed.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and accordion headings, list-row titles. Condensed.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines above headlines and inside tiles; section labels in settings. Semi-condensed.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Users with an expired card see a blank error state.
styles.usage: Input values, option labels, list rows, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Labels above fields, meta values, link text. Semi-condensed.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, timestamps, counts. Semi-condensed, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between label and control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside meta rows; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked fields; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (32px on wide cards).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tile padding; section spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a page headline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List-row highlight, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, steppers, popovers, upload zone.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and app bars.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Solid tiles (red, black, grey), bottom nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, avatars, toggles, progress bars, date cells.

size.note: Generous by design: the same sizes serve web and touch.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, filter chips.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons; icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, steppers, date pickers — on web and native.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edge width of inputs, outline buttons and outline chips (2px for outline buttons).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in rows, inputs and nav.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in meta rows and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and the date picker — together with a `line` border. Cards never cast shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-toast

tokens.usage: Menus and pickers.

tokens.name: z-nav
